name: fastpath
description: Kiro Fast-Path: warm local hybrid code index + thin MCP + Scout/Architect agent pack

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fastpath/core && npm run build -w @fastpath/mcp-server && npm run build -w @fastpath/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && FASTPATH_EMBED=hash FASTPATH_RERANK=off FASTPATH_PARSER=legacy FASTPATH_ALLOW_HASH=1 node --test test/*.test.js
scripts.test:connections: npm run build && FASTPATH_EMBED=hash FASTPATH_RERANK=off FASTPATH_PARSER=legacy node packages/mcp-server/dist/scripts/test-connections.js
scripts.eval: npm run build && FASTPATH_EMBED=hash FASTPATH_RERANK=off FASTPATH_PARSER=legacy node packages/cli/dist/index.js eval
scripts.eval:office: npm run build && FASTPATH_EMBED=hash FASTPATH_RERANK=off FASTPATH_PARSER=legacy node packages/cli/dist/index.js eval --office

author: rexymayderio
